# PoiBin {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
PoiBin{T <: Real}  <: DiscreteUnivariateDistribution
```
A struct to define a Poisson-Binomial distribution. 
 

```julia-repl
dist = PoiBin(0.5, 5)
rand(dist)
```


:::
